name: gradient-phoenix-start
title: Phoenix Start
description: A decorative vertical gradient block that glows golden yellow at the top edge and warms through amber and orange to red-orange at the bottom, with soft rounded corners.
use: A warm golden-to-red field is wanted behind a hero, card or call to action.
avoid: It is static flat colour, and white text struggles against the bright yellow top.
a11y: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it carries no information by itself. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle with a vertical gradient: bright golden yellow along the top edge, warming through amber and orange to a red-orange along the bottom. Black margins frame it.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The two warm colour stops are fixed, although classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
customise: The two gradient stops are baked into the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight: light: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.
